jobs.title: Manifest
jobs.description: Manifesto | Dream A New Reality - Read the CEO's Post > About Careers Research & News Manifest Contact Us Contact Us Nothing is standing in your way to sovereignty. Leaders have always sought to shape history. To build nations that don’t just survive, but flourish. To achieve the monumental. The once-impossible. For most of history, progress was limited. By resources. By geography. By time. Only a few nations, at a few moments, could leap forward - powered by breakthrough technologies that redefined what a nation could be. Now is one of those moments. A new force has emerged. One that doesn’t just accelerate progress, but redefines its limits: AI. A foundational infrastructure that, for the first time, allows frontier dreams to be scaled, shaped, and deployed at the scale of a nation. Most nations depend on systems that are built abroad. Governed abroad. Subject to the political and commercial decisions of others. Nations have been forced to accept that constraint. Until now. Data, intelligence, and AI infrastructure have become the terrain on which sovereignty is either built - or surrendered. This is our new reality: Nation-states that control their AI can shape their people's future. And those that don't, won't. Sovereign AI is not a luxury. It is the defining capability of the next era. Dream was built for the nations that refuse to be dependent. We build sovereign AI systems that are: Local. Fully controlled. Autonomously-customized. Deeply integrated. And aligned with the unique needs, ambitions, and identity of each nation. Dream turns sovereign AI into sovereign power, and enables nations to become super-nations. jobs.description: Privacy Policy | Dream A New Reality - Read the CEO's Post > About Careers Research & News Manifest Contact Us Contact Us Privacy Notice ‍ At Dream Security Ltd. and our affiliates (collectively, the "Company," or "we," "us," or "our") our customers trust us to protect their businesses and people from the sophisticated and ever-evolving cyberattacks of today and tomorrow. A critical part of earning and maintaining that trust is our commitment to ensuring that our products and systems are secure, and that we appropriately protect information relating to individuals. This Privacy Notice describes how we collect, use, and disclose information about visitors and users of our websites (each, a "Site," or collectively, "our Sites"), online features, and services that link to this Privacy Notice, and information we collect via offline means, such as during interactions with our corporate suppliers and customers, via trade shows or other offline interactions, where applicable. For the purposes of this Privacy Notice, Dream Security is a controller (i.e., responsible party) for the personal data practices described in this Privacy Notice. This Privacy Notice does not apply to the extent that we process personal data in the role of a processor or service provider (as applicable) on behalf of our business customers. For information about the privacy practices of a Company business customer or a customer affiliate, please contact the respective business customer directly. We are not responsible for the privacy or data security practices of our business customers, which may differ from those set forth in this Privacy Notice. You can access specific topics within this Privacy Notice by clicking on the relevant links below: Information the Company Collects Sources of Personal Data How We Use Personal Data? Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data When We Disclose Personal Data to Third Parties? Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies Your Choices Your Rights Security & Retention Children's Privacy Third Party Links Data Transfers Changes to this Privacy Notice Contact Information Information the Company Collects The types of information that indirectly or directly identify you ("personal data") we collect about you depend on how you interact with us. The following are the categories and specific types of personal data that we may collect: Contact Information/Identifiers , including name, email address, postal address, phone number, login credentials, business contact information, or other similar identifiers and account information. Government Identifiers , including national identification number, driver's license number, Social Security number, passport number, and/or other governmental identification number. Commercial Information , in certain instances, such as invoices, business and commercial communications, order status and history. Device Information and Other Unique Identifiers , including device identifier, internet protocol (IP) address, or similar unique identifiers. Internet or Other Network Activity , including browsing or search history, and information regarding your interactions with our Sites, emails, or advertisements. Geolocation Data , including information that permits us to determine your location, such as if you manually provide location information or enable your mobile device to send us location information. Payment Information , including bank account information, credit or debit card number, or other financial information (when purchasing products and services). Inferences , drawn from or created based on any of the personal data listed above. Aggregated or Deidentified Data , derived from the personal data listed above. Generally, the provision of personal data is voluntary (for possible exceptions, please see the "Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data" section below). However, we may not be able to fulfill the requested purpose of collection if you do not provide us with your personal data, such as to respond to your queries or for our normal business administration, such as projects, services, and billing. However, unless otherwise specified, not providing your personal data will not result in legal or other consequences to you. Sources of Personal Data We collect your personal data in the following ways: Directly From You , when you use our Sites, create an account and profile with us, respond to a survey or an information request, sign up to receive emails, and/or postal mailings, or otherwise contact us directly. Through Our Use of Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies , when you visit our Sites. We or third parties we work with automatically collect certain information using technologies such as cookies, web beacons, clear GIF, pixels, internet tags, web server logs, and other data collection tools. For more information, please see the "Cookies and Other Tracking Technologies" section below. Where legally required, we obtain your consent. From Our Third-Party Partners and Governmental Authorities , including from third parties that we have partnered with to provide you our Site and products and services or with whom we collaborate, as well as law enforcement and other government agencies. Social Media Platforms and Networks. If you interact with us on social media or use features such as plugins, widgets, or other tools made available by social media platforms (including LinkedIn) in connection with our websites or mobile applications ("Social Features"), both we and the social media platform may have access to information about you and your use of both the social media platform, and also our products and services. Additionally, if you use Social Features, information you post or make accessible may be publicly displayed by such third party. For more information about the privacy practices of those social media platforms, please review the privacy policies and settings of the social media platforms and networks that you use.
